foreign_currency_exposure: operations throughout the world that manufacture and sell products in various international markets; exposed to exchange rate movements relative to U.S. dollar reporting currency
cross_currency_swaps: enter into cross currency swaps to manage foreign currency translation risk on assets denominated in a functional currency other than the U.S. Dollar
hedge_designation: designated as partial hedge of investment in certain subsidiaries whose functional currency is not the U.S. Dollar
fair_value_measurement: measured at fair value using observable market inputs including forward, discount and interest rates
hedge_accounting: changes in fair value of cross currency swaps recorded in Equity; ineffective portion impacts net earnings
commodity_exposure: exposed to volatility in commodity prices; uses fixed price contracts with suppliers to manage exposure
no_commodity_hedges: no commodity hedge contracts in place at December 31, 2025
interest_rate_exposure: substantially all long-term debt has fixed interest rates; market rate fluctuation not expected to have material effect
